detail.text: In a 4-team trade, the Brooklyn Nets traded Nicolas Claxton to the Chicago Bulls ; the Brooklyn Nets traded Isaiah Evans to the Minnesota Timberwolves ; the Chicago Bulls traded Mouhamadou Gueye to the Charlotte Hornets ; the Charlotte Hornets traded LaMelo Ball and Josh Green to the Minnesota Timberwolves ; the Minnesota Timberwolves traded Joshua Jefferson and Julius Randle to the Brooklyn Nets ; and the Minnesota Timberwolves traded Naz Reid , Matteo Spagnolo , a 2028 1st round draft pick, a 2029 1st round draft pick, a 2029 2nd round draft pick, a 2030 1st round draft pick, a 2032 2nd round draft pick, a 2033 1st round draft pick and a 2033 2nd round draft pick to the Charlotte Hornets . 2028 1st-rd pick is a swap 2029 1st-rd pick is a swap 2029 2nd-rd pick is MIN own 2030 1st-rd pick is a swap 2032 2nd-rd pick is MIN own 2033 1st-rd pick is MIN own 2033 2nd-rd pick is MIN own Charlotte received a trade exception.
